title: Launch Monitor Ball Speed Goal Adherence by Club
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=launchmonitor:shot
| stats avg(ball_speed_mph) as actual count as sessions by club
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/145.0,1), goal_label="145"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average ball speed in miles per hour with a simple target for each club, showing where launch monitor ball speed is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by club shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence club values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of club values with average ball speed in miles per hour and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which club settings help you hit your target for launch monitor ball speed and which ones fall short.
